subject: Copywriting
title: Fear: The Oldest Motivator
description: A fast breakdown of Fear: The Oldest Motivator for builders.

hook.text: Insurance ads show car wrecks. Security ads show break-ins. Fear sells because survival instinct is stronger than logic.

buildup.text: Fear appeals activate the amygdala, bypassing rational thought. The body responds before the mind can argue.

discovery.text: Anti-smoking ads with graphic images cut smoking rates by 20%. Mild warnings had zero effect. Fear needs intensity.

twist.text: Too much fear paralyzes. If the threat feels hopeless, people ignore it. Effective fear copy always offers a solution.

climax.text: The formula: scare, then solve. Show the pain, then show the escape. Fear without hope is noise.

punchline.text: Scare, then solve. Fear without a fix is wasted.

quiz.question: Why do fear appeals need to include a solution?
options: Too much fear paralyzes and people ignore it
